title: EnerGNN: Learning Optimization-Compatible Energy Functions for Exact Constrained Combinatorial Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.33930v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning-based approaches to combinatorial optimization often predict solutions directly or use predictions to restrict search, while expressive energy-based models typically rely on approximate inference. We introduce EnerGNN, a framework that learns energy functions over complete binary configurations and minimizes them under explicit hard constraints through mixed integer programming (MIP). EnerGNN combines a graph neural network encoder with an optimization-compatible readout and a nonlinear energy head, enabling exact constrained inference over the learned energy. An optimality-aware contrastive loss trains the energy to reflect solution quality and constraint violations. Across Quadratic Knapsack, Combinatorial Auctions, and a personalized cell therapy supply chain problem, EnerGNN achieves near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility. translated_title: EnerGNN：学习与优化兼容的能量函数以实现精确的约束组合推理
translated_abstract: 组合优化的基于学习的方法通常直接预测解或利用预测来限制搜索范围，而表达力强的基于能量的模型通常依赖近似推理。我们提出了EnerGNN，这是一个在完整二值配置上学习能量函数，并通过混合整数规划（MIP）在显式硬约束下对其进行最小化的框架。EnerGNN将图神经网络编码器与优化兼容的读出层和非线性能量头相结合，从而能够对学习到的能量函数进行精确的约束推理。一种最优性感知的对比损失用于训练能量函数，使其反映解的质量和约束违反情况。在二次背包问题、组合拍卖以及个性化细胞疗法供应链问题上，EnerGNN实现了100%可行性的近最优解。在供应链问题上，它取得了0.05%的平均原始间隙和相对于基线方法17.4倍的加速（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: EnerGNN提出了一个学习优化兼容能量函数的新框架，通过混合整数规划在硬约束下实现精确的约束组合推理，在多个组合优化问题上实现了100%可行性的近最优解并带来显著加速。
en_tdlr: EnerGNN learns optimization-compatible energy functions that are exactly minimized under hard constraints via mixed integer programming, achieving near-optimal solutions with 100% feasibility and significant speedups across combinatorial optimization problems.
